title: Reducing the Data Complexity of the Full MISTY1 Attack
summary: The full MISTY1 attack has impractically high data complexity; reducing it remains open, with lower-order six-round integral characteristics suggested as a possible route.

formal_statement.body: The attack on full $\mathrm{MISTY1}$ has impractically high data complexity. Determine whether this data complexity can be reduced, potentially by finding additional six-round integral characteristics of lower order.

scope.domain: Integral cryptanalysis of the full MISTY1 block cipher.
parameters: Data complexity: the attack resource targeted for reduction
Order of six-round integral characteristics: a proposed lever for reducing data complexity
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the attack's data complexity can be reduced, potentially by finding additional lower-order six-round integral characteristics.

citations.label: A 2^70 Attack on the Full MISTY1

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents reducing the attack's data complexity as a problem for further research and suggests finding additional lower-order six-round integral characteristics as a possible direction.
citation_labels: Achiya Bar-On et al., A 2^70 Attack on the Full MISTY1
